text: Confirmed: `required` is ignored for `is_flag` options — fixing in src/click/core.py.
Confirmed: with no console attached (pythonw.exe) sys.stdout/stderr is None and click.echo/progressbar/pager crash with AttributeError. Fixing None-stream handling so output is dropped.
Confirmed: envvar value used raw instead of the option's `flag_value`. Fixing value_from_envvar so a flag option always yields its flag_value.

Confirmed: a decorator built once (`click.argument(...)`/`click.option(...)`) holds a single Parameter object that gets mutated when attached, so reusing it on a second command yields a plain Parameter. Fixing so each command gets its own configured parameter. ETA ~10 min.

Confirmed: with resolve_path=True, a symlink whose target is relative is resolved against the current working directory instead of the link's directory (realpath applied in the wrong order). Fixing in click.Path. ETA ~10 min.
Confirmed: the help record for a flag ignores the default map, so `--help` shows `default: no-name` while the value is True. Fixing so show_default reflects the default_map value. ETA ~10 min.

Fixed and verified: `is_flag=True` with `required=True` now errors with `Error: Missing option '--on'.` (exit 2) when omitted. Cause: Option.__init__ forced `default=False` for flags regardless of `required`. Full test suite green.

Fixed and verified: with sys.stdout/sys.stderr None (pythonw.exe), click.echo silently drops output, and progressbar/pager fall back to a throwaway stream instead of raising AttributeError. Full test suite green.

Fixed and verified: a non-boolean flag with `flag_value` + `envvar` now yields its `flag_value` (`UPPER=whatever` prints `upper`). Boolean flags still parse the env text as a bool, and count options still count. Full test suite green.

Fixed and verified: a decorator built once (`click.argument(...)`/`click.option(..., cls=...)`) can now be reused on several commands — each command gets its own parameter of your custom class. Cause: the inner decorator popped `cls` out of the shared captured attrs. Full test suite green.

Fixed and verified: `click.Path(resolve_path=True)` on a symlink with a relative target now returns the absolute real path (`/tmp/demo/real.txt` instead of `/real.txt`). Cause: an `os.readlink` shortcut resolved the relative target against the CWD; now realpath (pathlib on Windows/Py<3.8) is used. Full test suite green.
Fixed and verified: with `show_default=True`, the help record now honors the default map, so `--help` shows `[default: name]` when `default_map` sets the flag True. Full test suite green.
